## Change and acceptance

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and observable acceptance cases.
Link the issue or state the request; small fixes do not need a new ticket.

## Impact and compatibility

Name affected readers/writers and linked cross-repo PRs. Cover existing installed
iOS clients, identity/authorization, retries/partial failure and release order where
relevant. For UI, include branch screenshots with synthetic data when useful.

## Verification

List commands and actual results, including failures/skips and unrun checks.
For fixes, name the regression case. Distinguish mocked, emulator, browser,
physical-device and deployed evidence. No production data in screenshots/logs.

## Release and recovery

State required deployment/configuration, rollout and rollback. Source merge is
not production release. AI review is advisory; a human approves and merges.
